note: Blank recipe with every section for FireRed / LeafGreen. Replace null with piece numbers from your slice preview and delete the sections you don't need; anything left out or null falls back to another look or the game's own sprite. Use family "frlg_wide" for 32-wide art. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

_how.piece: a number from the slice preview, e.g. 12
_how.one-row sections: can be a plain list, e.g. "back": [12, 13, 14]
_how.surf drawn with its mount: use "surf with blob": {"down": [4 pieces], "up": [...], "left": [...]} instead of "surf" and "surf blob"

_sections.front: front.png: 1 frame. battle front pic, also the trainer card
_sections.back: back.png: 5 frames. battle back pic: idle first, then the throw (wind-up, two quick frames, thrown)
_sections.walk: walk.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. stand, step, step
_sections.run: walk.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. run frames, in the game's order
_sections.bike: bike.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. stand, pedal, pedal
_sections.fish: fishing.png: 4 down, 4 up, 4 left. the cast, in order
_sections.surf: surf.png: 4 down, 4 up, 4 left. sit, step, step, jump
_sections.field move / vs seeker: fieldMove.png: 9 frames. using an HM, then holding up the VS Seeker
_sections.vs seeker bike: vsSeekerBike.png: 6 frames. VS Seeker on the bike
_sections.walk extra: walk.png: 2 frames. two extra frames (a stand frame works)
_sections.map icon: mapIcon.png: 1 frame. 16x16 head for the town map
_sections.fly (off / in): flyBird.png: 2 frames. flying off, flying in (draw the bird too)
_sections.surf blob: surfBlob.png (extras): 2 down, 2 up, 2 left. the surf mount (FRLG has 2 bob frames per facing)
_sections.fly bird: bird.png (extras): 1 frame. the Fly bird on its own
_sections.bag: bag.png (extras): 4 frames. bag picture(s) in the bag menu
